verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs explicitly describe an open-source, self-hostable version that runs 'the same memory engine as the Platform' on infrastructure you control, shipped as a Docker stack with REST API, dashboard, per-user API keys, and audit log (mem0-docs-4, mem0-docs-21, mem0-docs-22, mem0-docs-28, mem0-docs-36, mem0-docs-43). This directly matches the platform-engineer self-host story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the Docker self-host setup actually works as documented (all evidence is vendor docs, no community verification of self-hosted deployment specifically) and detail on infra requirements (e.g., vector DB dependencies) for production self-hosting.
